primary.title: How SCSS helps senior citizens earn a ₹20,500 monthly income from ₹30 lakh savings
primary.summary: Secure your retirement with SCSS, a government-backed savings scheme offering stable income for senior citizens. This article explains how a ₹30 lakh investment can generate around ₹20,500 monthly income with safety, tax benefits and predictable returns.
